status: PAPER TEST, not a live list
title: Paper test #1: Quality + Trend (QTRX)
method: High cash-quality companies in an uptrend with moderate volatility, ranked by 12-month momentum and quality. Universe: US-listed stocks over $2B with SEC us-gaap filings (870 stocks; 145 pass every rule), excluding financials, real estate, bitcoin miners and crypto-treasury companies. Percentile ranks are across that universe. Picks are the top 12 in score order with at most 3 per industry and 6 semiconductor/hardware names; the next 13 are backups. As backtested, picks are held for a quarter: weekly refreshes update the numbers, and the list is rebuilt at the quarterly rebalance (next: 2027-02-22).

rubric.how: Ranked by the average of 12-1 momentum (percentile) and cash quality (percentile).

dataNotes: Fundamentals: SEC XBRL companyfacts, originally filed values, filings public by the 2026-11-23 close; quarters older than 230 days are ignored. Prices: Yahoo daily adjusted closes (month-end closes for the 10-month average, momentum and volatility; daily closes for the 150/200-day averages). Forward P/E, PEG, analysts and targets: StockAnalysis. Same code as the Nov 23, 2026 backtest harness.
backtest: Backtest 2012–Nov 2026 (SEC + Yahoo, top 1,000 US stocks, 25 names, quarterly, 10 bp costs): +1.2 to +2.2%/yr vs the same-universe equal-weight basket, Sharpe about 0.8, max drawdown about −30%. 1975–2025 survivorship-free check (OSAP/CRSP proxy): +5.0%/yr vs the market; +10.7%/yr in 1975–2004. It lagged in 2020–26 and in the Jul–Nov 2026 reversal.
disclaimer: Paper test only (user-approved Nov 23, 2026): not a live list, nothing is traded, and the live screeners are unchanged. Backtests overstate future returns. Not financial advice.
